name: Raising Hands
overview: Scripture portrays raising hands as a meaningful act of faith, worship, and dependence on God. In Exodus 17:11, Moses’ uplifted hands symbolize intercession and victory for Israel, while Nehemiah 8:6 shows the people lifting their hands in unified praise and blessing toward the LORD. The Psalms emphasize lifting hands in prayer and devotion, expressing trust in God's commandments and seeking His presence, as seen in Psalms 28:2, 63:4, 119:48, and 134:2. Together, these verses reveal raising hands as a biblical posture of blessing, supplication, and heartfelt worship directed to the holy God.
